applicabilityBasis.summary: pendleUSDC is the share of the exact Ethereum Morpho Vault V2 deployment 0x55c1b6e461a6334b567baf0feb5d728715446f05, which lends USDC to Pendle principal-token collateral markets. Shares accrue interest, realize lending losses and redeem according to variable asset/share accounting and available liquidity. The product is a strategy position rather than a fixed-monetary-value payment token or an issuer obligation to redeem at a fixed amount under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment applies to the vault share separately from underlying USDC. Armitage terms identify Corto Industries Limited in the Cayman Islands as curator and technical-service provider, not a legal issuer promising fixed-value payment redemption for this share. issuerEntity is omitted consistently with the Morpho vault family. The exact lower-yield Pendle Ecosystem USDC deployment was distinguished from the separate Pendle Ecosystem High Yield USDC vault. Underlying USDC licenses, reserves and attestations are not share-level authorization or attestations. This classification does not determine whether securities or other laws apply.
